test_share_live_view.title: Verify sharing a live view via email and copying the share link

steps.action: Navigate to the Views page and wait for it to load
steps.expected: Views page loads with tile grid visible

steps.action: Ensure at least one camera is streaming in a tile (expand Driver Site and add camera if needed)
steps.expected: Video tile is visible with live stream

steps.action: Hover the tile, open three-dot menu, and click the share icon
Enter email address and click Share
Click Copy to copy the share link
steps.expected: Share link is copied to clipboard
Share dialog closes and tile is still visible
